route: /style-board/ (the style board: module splitMedia:tinted, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: On desktop, the body paragraphs run the full width of the copy column at a small size, so lines reach about 80–87 characters (e.g. 'That cuts your development cost and your fit risk for a first collection. You can build'); splitMedia-2 does the same ('Order one before you decide between screen printing, heat transfers, embroidery or'). That is above the treatment practice's 70ch measure and its 80ch audit limit.
findings.reference: The competitor's split copy keeps its paragraphs to a narrower column, at roughly 70–75 characters per line beside the media.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, give the splitMedia copy's paragraphs a max-width of about 68ch, or raise the split copy's body font-size on desktop to the mobile size, so lines stay under 70ch. Keep the copy column's edge shared with the photo, and leave the heading's size to the template's fit.
